service: Raven — signed token-launch verification for agent commerce

tiers.name: MCP (local)
tiers.notes: Runs against your own RPC. Same engine and finding vocabulary, but LOCAL RESULTS ARE UNSIGNED - no signed attestation is issued. The package's linked source repository and issue tracker are private (404 for external users). Developer path only; use the hosted signed API for receipt verification. Its npm README is legacy documentation - do not take the primary endpoint or any trust pin from it.

tiers.name: Hosted signed API
tiers.legacy_endpoint: POST /verify — legacy v2 compatibility only; not recommended for new integrations
tiers.rate_limits: POST /receipt/v1: 15 requests/min per key. POST /verify: 10 requests/min per key, burst 4.
tiers.guarantees: Receipt-v1 Ed25519-signed evidence with findings, coverageGaps, slot, payloadHash, receiptId, signerPublicKey, and signature. Required evidence/signing failures issue no receipt; receipt_unavailable is an unsigned refusal.

tiers.name: ACP job (agent-to-agent)
tiers.access: sandbox only via Virtuals Agent Commerce Protocol; not publicly listed in the ACP registry
tiers.settlement: escrowed USDC, signed deliverable, on-chain settlement (intended design; not a live capability today)
tiers.notes: Not publicly listed. No live ACP jobs are available today; use the hosted signed API, which requires an API key.
tiers.availability: not publicly available; sandbox agents are not discoverable or hireable in the ACP marketplace

tiers.name: Holder-beta (advanced)
tiers.adds: Top-holder concentration with venue-adjusted exclusions: pump.fun bonding-curve and registered PumpSwap pool vaults excluded ONLY with decoded on-chain evidence; unadjusted results carry an explicit qualifier and coverage gap.

disclaimer: Raven verifies on-chain evidence. It does not predict price or guarantee safety.
payment_note: Raven supports stablecoin-native agent payments through ACP (USDC per job). This is a payment rail for verification services — not an investment product, not financial advice.
founding_alpha: Hosted access free for design partners during alpha; paid tiers from EUR 99/mo at GA (10k signed verifications), EUR 299/mo (75k), integrations from EUR 1,500/mo. Founding users keep a permanent discount. Verification service only — not an investment product.
